recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided into four equal quadrants, each featuring a geometric spiral constructed from triangles. The artwork utilizes a watercolor medium on textured paper, showing visible brushstrokes and pigment pooling within a rigid grid structure.
coreVisualRelationships: Mathematical precision of the grid versus organic watercolor texture
Color-coded quadrants (green, grey, brown, yellow) creating a balanced cycle
Centripetal movement of triangles towards the center of each quadrant
High contrast between dark and light facets within each spiral

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central square block occupying approximately 70% of the canvas, centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection point of the four quadrants in the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the spiral rotation in each quadrant, moving clockwise from top-left to bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample off-white, textured paper border surrounding the central geometric block.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (sage green, slate grey, taupe, ochre) defining each quadrant.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and off-white used for sharp tonal shifts within the triangles.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow-orange in the bottom-right quadrant providing a focal point of warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between adjacent triangular facets.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to four primary tonal families

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Handwritten script with organic, slightly irregular strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Varying line weight suggestive of a brush or ink pen
Fluid, connected-style lowercase with a distinctive capital-like first letter
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a deep, rounded bowl and a sharp terminal
The 'y' features a long, sweeping descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Standalone signature-style lettering to contrast the rigid geometry.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the organic feel of the watercolor medium.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square grid divided into four quadrants on textured cream watercolor paper. Each quadrant contains a geometric spiral made of triangles. Top-left is sage green, top-right is slate grey, bottom-left is earthy brown, bottom-right is ochre yellow. Use watercolor textures with visible pigment pooling.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, handwritten-style signature in the bottom-right corner using a dark brown ink or watercolor effect.

verificationChecks: Ensure the grid lines are visible but not digitally perfect.
Check that each quadrant has a distinct color identity.
Verify the paper texture is consistent across the negative space.
Confirm the spiral direction is consistent across all four quadrants.

adjustableVariables: Color palette of the four quadrants
postGenerationChecks: Does the image look like it was painted on paper?
Are the four quadrants clearly defined?
Is the spiral effect achieved through tonal contrast?
Is the signature-style text small and unobtrusive?
Is the overall composition balanced and centered?
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a 2x2 grid of [Color A, Color B, Color C, Color D] geometric spirals using [Medium] on [Surface Texture], maintaining a [Composition Style] with a small [Text Style] signature in the corner.
